answer: Anchor each agent identity to one vehicle title in the DMV registry: the title's VIN is hashed into the agent's key, and the registry refuses a second identity on the same VIN, so the kernel of the check is a title record, not a self-asserted claim. An attacker wanting a thousand sockpuppets must buy, title, and insure a thousand vehicles, so forgery scales with real-world cost while one honest agent pays nothing extra. Keep an atlas of title offices that issued attestations, and flag any transferred VIN; the umber limit is fleet owners and leased cars, so non-drivers need a second path.
